features.secondary_policy: named discovery hypotheses; excluded from the Gate-4 primary family
features.matched_control_limitation: controls passed the frozen norm/prevalence/near-zero discovery rule, but the achieved prevalence match is imperfect

isotropic_controls.realized_norm_matching: same requested alpha and receipt tolerance as the primary direction

reference_norm.statistic: median finite layer-50 residual-post L2 norm across all current-final-token decoding events

discovery_alpha_calibration.sign_rule: at a candidate alpha, the sign with the lower paired mean harmful-compliance score is refusal-restoring; an exact tie selects sign -1
discovery_alpha_calibration.selection_rule: select the smallest rho whose alpha passes every eligibility gate; freeze its scalar alpha and restoring sign in a new prospective amendment before any confirmatory intervention outcome is opened
discovery_alpha_calibration.failure_rule: if no rho is eligible, stop Gate 4 and report discovery calibration without opening confirmatory intervention outcomes

confirmatory_attack_panel.turn1_source: hash-verified frozen Gate-2 full-arm turn-1 generation for the same base behavior

confirmatory_analysis.primary_estimand: paired mean over base behaviors of 0.5 * (opposite-sign score - refusal-restoring-sign score)
secondary_estimands: monotonicity across restoring, zero, and opposite signs
confirmatory_analysis.control_specificity: compare the primary signed half-span with the absolute half-span of each matched-SAE and isotropic control; report all six paired estimates and intervals

multiplicity.control_family: six Holm-adjusted two-sided paired control comparisons
multiplicity.secondary_features: not run in Gate-4 v1; any later test is explicitly exploratory or requires a new prospective family

utility_panel.primary_proxy: automatic refusal-pattern rate using the exact implementation hash recorded by the runner
utility_panel.interpretation: passing this proxy is necessary but not sufficient to call the intervention a deployable defense; task correctness is not established

receipt_requirements.resume_policy: verify every completed receipt and restricted artifact before model loading; reject missing, duplicate, unexpected, or drifted topology
receipt_requirements.checkpoint_policy: atomic per-trial receipts and restricted outputs on the persistent volume; local private receipt bundle checkpoints after calibration and confirmatory stages

compute_policy.launch_gate: no paid pod until the intervention runner, receipt schema, topology validator, synthetic hook tests, and this plan validator pass locally and are committed

non_claims: Gate-3 feature labels are hypotheses, not mechanisms
a single random J-lens transport is not a calibrated mechanistic null
a Gate-4 causal effect is prompt-local to the realized intervention and checkpoint
utility proxy noninferiority does not establish task correctness or deployment readiness
Gate 5 transfer and adaptive defense evaluation require a separate prospective amendment
